pub assume_specification<T, A: Allocator>[
    VecDeque::<T, A>::resize_with
](
    v: &mut VecDeque<T, A>,
    new_len: usize,
    generator: impl FnMut() -> T,
)

        (new_len as int) > old(v)@.len() ==> generator.requires(()),
    ensures
        (new_len as int) <= old(v)@.len() ==>
            final(v)@ == old(v)@.subrange(0, new_len as int),
        (new_len as int) > old(v)@.len() ==> {
            &&& final(v)@.len() == new_len as int
            &&& final(v)@.subrange(0, old(v)@.len()) == old(v)@
            &&& forall|i: int|
                old(v)@.len() <= i < new_len as int
                    ==> generator.ensures((), final(v)@[i])
        },
;
requires: Growth requires the generator's zero-argument precondition.
ensures: Shrinking retains exactly the requested prefix.
Growing preserves the old prefix and appends one allowed generator output per new position.
candidates.rationale: The sequence view expresses truncation, prefix preservation, final length, and the relation of every appended element to the generator contract.
risks: The relation records allowed outputs but not call order or mutable-capture state transitions.
